chapterInfo.content:
14
Ɛweɛ berɛ ne emu hia
1AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Yeremia nkyɛn ɛfa osuo a ɛrentɔ ho no nie:
2Yuda di abooboo
na n’aponkɛseɛ agogo,
wɔboa fam si wɔn tiri ase twann,
na Yerusalem nteamu foro kɔ soro.
3Na wɔn mu akɛseɛ soma nkumaa no nsuosa;
wɔba nsubɔnhwa ano,
wɔnnya nsuo;
wɔde wɔn nhina hunu sane ba,
wɔn ani awuwu, wɔn anim agu ase,
wɔkatakata wɔn ti.
4 # Yoel 1.11 Osuo a ɛntɔ asase no soɔ
na fam awo pɛsɛɛ nti,
akuafoɔ ani awuwu,
wɔakatakata wɔn ti.
5Na mfofo so forotebereɛ nso, ɔwo a, ɔgya ne mma,
ɛfiri sɛ wira biara nni hɔ.
6Na ɛserɛ so mfunumu gyinagyina mpampa so,
wɔhome mframa sɛ ɛserɛ so kraman,
wɔn ani ayɛ siamoo,
ɛfiri sɛ nhahan biara nni hɔ.
7 # Dan 9.4-14 Sɛ yɛn amumuyɛ kasa tia yɛn mpo a,
AWURADE, wo din nti yɛ ɛho biribi,
na yɛn nsaneakyire adɔɔso,
wo na yɛayɛ wo bɔne.
8O Israel anidasoɔ,
wo a wogye wɔn ohia berɛ mu,
ɛdeɛn nti na woyɛ sɛ asase yi so hɔhoɔ,
sɛ ɔkwantenni a ɔsoɛ anadwo?
9 # Yer 15.16; Yes 43.7 Ɛdeɛn nti na woyɛ sɛ ɔbarima a wɔatu n’akoma,
sɛ dɔmmarima a ɔntumi nnye nkwa?
Nso wo ara na wowɔ yɛn mfimfini, AWURADE,
na wɔde wo din ato yɛn;
nnya yɛn hɔ.
10Sɛ AWURADE ka wɔ ɔman yi ho nie:
Saa ara na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔwɔ ntwɛtwɛdɛ,
wɔansi wɔn nan kwan;
enti AWURADE nso ani nsɔ wɔn;
afei na wakae wɔn amumuyɛ
rebɛtua wɔn bɔne so ka.
11 # Yer 7.16; 11.14 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mpa kyɛw nsrɛ papa mma ɔman yi. 12#Yer 6.20; Yes 58.3 Sɛ wɔdi mmuada mpo a, merentie wɔn nkotosrɛ; na sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ a, m’ani rensɔ wɔn, na afena ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ na mede bɛdwerɛ wɔn koraa.
13Na mese: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, hwɛ, adiyifoɔ no ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Morenhunu afena, na ɛkɔm remma mo so, na nokorɛ asomdwoeɛ na mede bɛma mo ɛha yi. 14#Yer 23.21; 27.14-15; 28.8-9 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Atorɔ na adiyifoɔ no de hyɛ me din mu nkɔm; mensomaa wɔn, na menhyɛɛ wɔn, na menkasa menkyerɛɛ wɔn; atorɔ anisoadehunu ne nkɔmhyɛ ne asɛnhunu ne wɔn akoma mu nnaadaa na wɔka kyerɛ mo yi. 15#Deut 18.20 Ɛno nti sɛ AWURADE ka adiyifoɔ a wɔde me din hyɛ nkɔm nanso ɛnyɛ me na mesomaa wɔn, na wɔn deɛ, wɔka sɛ: Afena ne ɛkɔm remma asase yi so, no ho nie: Afena ne ɛkɔm ara na ɛbɛdwerɛ adiyifoɔ no. 16#Yer 8.2 Na ɔman a adiyifoɔ no hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ wɔn no, ɛkɔm ne afena no nti wɔbɛgugu Yerusalem mmorɔno so, na obiara biara nni hɔ a ɔbɛsie wɔn, wɔn ne wɔn yerenom ne wɔn mmabanin ne wɔn mmammaa nyinaa; na mɛma wɔn bɔne abua wɔn atifi.
17 # Yer 9.1 Enti ka nsɛm yi kyerɛ wɔn sɛ:
M’ani porepore nisuo anadwo ne awia,
na ɛnnyae,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔde bobɔ kɛseɛ abobɔ me man babaa baabunu,
wɔapira no ma no ayɛ ya sɛ.
18Sɛ mefiri mekɔ wiram a,
hwɛ, afena ano atɔfoɔ nie;
na sɛ meba kuro mu a,
hwɛ, ɛkɔm ano atɔfo nie;
na odiyifoɔ ne ɔsɔfoɔ nyinaa kyinkyini asase no so,
nso wɔnnim deɛ wɔrekorɔ.
Odiyifoɔ no dima
19 # Yer 8.15 Toɔ na woato Yuda atwene,
anaasɛ Sion ho ayɛ wo kra nwunu?
Ɛdeɛn nti na woabubu yɛn
na yɛnni ɔyaresafoɔ yi?
Yɛhwɛ asomdwoeɛ kwan, nso papa biara amma;
yɛhwɛ ɔyaresa berɛ kwan nso, na hwɛ, akomatuo na ɛwɔ hɔ.
20 # Yer 14.7 O AWURADE, yɛahunu yɛn abususɛm,
yɛn agyanom amumuyɛ,
sɛ yɛayɛ wo bɔne.
21Wo din nti, mpa yɛn;
ngu w’animuonyam adwa no anim ase;
kae, mmubu w’apam a ɛda yɛne wo ntam no.
22Amanaman ahoni no mu bi wɔ hɔ a wɔma osuo torɔ?
Anaasɛ ɔsoro bɛtumi ama asuso atue?
Ɛnyɛ wo, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn?
Wo na yɛhwɛ wo kwan,
ɛfiri sɛ wo ara na woayɛ yeinom nyinaa.

wɔnnya nsuo;

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
